newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN SET TO SIGN LIZARAZU.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN SET TO SIGN LIZARAZU.

text.p: Bayern Munich are set to sign French international defender Bixente Lizarazu from Athletic Bilbao on a five-year contract, German sports magazine Kicker reported on Monday.
Kicker said Bayern and the player had already agreed the length of the contract and his salary and he was expected to join the German club in the close season.
Lizarazu has a clause in his contract allowing him to leave the Spanish club for a transfer fee of around seven million marks ($4 million), Kicker said.
Lizarazu would slot into the left wing-back position vacated by Christian Ziege, who joins AC Milan at the end of the season.
Karlsruhe's Michael Tarnat, who will also join Bayern in the summer, had also been pencilled in for Ziege's position.
But Kicker said he was now more likely to play in the left-sided midfield role currently occupied by Christian Nerlinger, who has rejected a new contract with Bayern.
